title: Learning to Diagnose and Correct Moral Errors: Towards Enhancing Moral Sensitivity in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper's central theme is to enhance 'moral sensitivity' in Large Language Models. It proposes specific methods to enable LLMs to diagnose and correct 'moral errors' and grounds its approach in Moral Foundation Theory (MFT), which is used to analyze moral situations and guide corrections. This focus on morals and ethics is integral to the paper's core contribution, not just a peripheral consideration.
